about: Ola's cards (OLA-325): each input as opencode sends it, and every line the card must show, in order. web/server/cards.mjs makes the description; web/test/cards.test.mjs, the web check (check.mjs, the cards page in Chromium and WebKit) and OlaKit's CardsTests all read this file. Made-up content only.
